method: Read-only git log/show/diff and -S/-G searches on the cloned default-branch histories; excluded every SHA in used-commits-v4.txt. Sorted selected cases by (project, kind, full commit SHA), shuffled with Python random.Random(20261016).shuffle, then assigned w01..w20. Changed-line counts are additions plus deletions using git diff -M --numstat, including comments; file lists include both endpoints of renames. Control follow-up checks extend through each clone's default-branch tip. The declaration-only decimal.js control changes no runtime behavior; the typings-only exclusion applies to BUG cases.

cases.ground_truth:
BUG: applyPatch stops processing EOF-newline markers after the first marker, mishandling a replacement whose old and new final lines both lack a newline. The regression patch replacing banana with babaco in 'foo
bar
baz
banana' should return 'foo
bar
baz
babaco' without adding a trailing newline.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Fix more logic around newlines at EOF - this time stuff I recently broke in (pre-release) changes to applyPatch (#536)'. Added tests under 'when the last line is changed but both old & new version have no trailing newline...' cover successful application, strict rejection of an unexpected newline, and fuzzy application.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes a redundant typeof guard before calling isProtoKey, whose own predicate handles the argument check.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'remove useless typeof test'. Checked subsequent default-branch path history, revert messages, and -S for 'if (isProtoKey(key))'; no later source change, reversal, or corrective fix was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces the private configuration-copying helper with Object.assign.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'refactor: Use Object.assign instead of custom function. (#168)'. Checked later index.js history, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for the removed helper and configuration assignment through the TypeScript migration. The later prototype-key fix retains Object.assign and addresses separate object-key handling; no fix or revert of this substitution was found.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: With includePrerelease enabled, exact zero-major caret ranges incorrectly lower their starting version to a prerelease. For example, satisfies('0.0.3-alpha', '^0.0.3', {includePrerelease: true}) returns true despite the version preceding the range's lower bound.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'fix: align caret includePrerelease lower bounds (#872)'. Added exclusion fixtures require '^0.0.3' to exclude '0.0.3-alpha' and '^0.2.3' to exclude '0.2.3-alpha' with includePrerelease enabled.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Migrates TrieUtils from JavaScript to TypeScript with parameter and return annotations, and adjusts related type-checker comments.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Migrate TrieUtils to TS'. Checked later history of both rename endpoints and deepEqual.ts, revert messages, and -S searches for the introduced declarations. The only later path change is import sorting; no corrective fix or reversal of the migration was found.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Rendering image alternative text silently drops inline-code content. The input '![foo *bar* `baz` bla](image.png)' loses baz instead of producing alt='foo bar baz bla'.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Show inline `code` content in image `alt` tag #1142'. The added 'Code in image description (#1142)' fixture requires the image alt attribute to contain 'foo bar baz bla'.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: tzOffset adds the minute component to negative hour offsets instead of subtracting it. For America/St_Johns at '2023-03-03T18:00:00.000Z', it returns -150 minutes rather than -210; the daylight-saving example similarly returns -90 rather than -150.
cases.evidence: Subject: '(tz): fix: add America/St_Johns handling to tzOffset'. Added standard-time and daylight-saving tests require offsets of -210 and -150 minutes for the two supplied March 2023 timestamps.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces arguments-array conversion with rest parameters and uses util.format directly instead of a forwarding wrapper.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'refactor: remove usage of `arguments` (#169)'. Checked later path history, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for extendAliases and the formatter assignment through the TypeScript and ESM migrations. Later edits preserve the rest-parameter implementation and direct formatter delegation; no corrective fix or revert was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds TypeScript narrowing support by declaring isDecimal as a type predicate in both declaration files, without changing runtime behavior.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Use type predicate on isDecimal'. Checked subsequent histories of both declaration files, revert messages, and -G searches for 'static isDecimal'; no later change to the predicate, corrective fix, or reversal was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Extracts the existing isPlainObject implementation into a shared utility and updates its imports.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Move isPlainObject to utils'. Checked subsequent path histories, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for isPlainObject and Object.getPrototypeOf(data). Later mapping fixes concern key access and representation; the extracted predicate's logic remains unchanged, with no extraction-related fix or revert.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Renames the internal valid-range module to valid and updates the export wiring and corresponding test import.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'remove duplicative naming. ranges/valid-range -> ranges/valid'. Checked later histories of the entry point and both module paths, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for the old and new import paths. Later preload and export changes retain ranges/valid; no correction or reversal of the rename was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Removes an unreachable negative-position adjustment from patch application.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Remove dead code'. Checked subsequent apply.js history, revert messages, and -S for 'if (toPos < 0)' across later history. The guard is never restored; subsequent newline fixes address separate EOF handling, followed by an algorithm rewrite, with no identified fix of a regression from this deletion.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Adds support and constructor overloads for creating TZDate from an existing Date, with timezone-specific tests.
cases.evidence: Subject: '(tz): Allow creating TZDate from Date'. Checked subsequent history and -S/-G searches for the Date-input branch, including imported package history and later package moves, plus revert messages. The later invalid-date fix preserves this branch and corrects general validation and a separate setter typo; no fix or revert of Date-input support was found.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces imported constructFromSymbol constants with equivalent Symbol.for('constructDateFrom') expressions in the two date classes.
cases.evidence: Subject: '(tz): Simplify the date construct symbol usage'. Checked subsequent source history, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for constructFromSymbol and constructDateFrom across the imported package and later layout. No fix or reversal of these equivalent symbol-key expressions was found.

cases.ground_truth:
BUG: The parser only strips a byte-order mark at the stream's initial position and fails to recognize BOM-prefixed later document boundaries. For example, loadAll('---
foo: bar
﻿---
abc: 5
') should return two mappings rather than failing to separate the documents.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Fix BOM handling at document boundaries, close #791'. Expanded BOM tests cover a leading BOM before a document or comment, and 'accepts BOM before each document in a stream' requires three correctly separated documents.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Makes getScalarValue accept the input string directly instead of a ParserState object, updating its callers.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'Remove `ParserState` dependency from getScalarValue'. Checked later histories of all three source files, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for getScalarValue and its changed calls. Subsequent edits continue passing input directly, with no corrective fix or reversal of this parameter refactor.

cases.ground_truth: CONTROL: Replaces deprecated substr calls with equivalent slice expressions in table extraction and quote replacement.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'refactor: replace deprecated String.prototype.substr()'. Checked later histories through module renames, revert messages, and -S/-G searches for both slice expressions. Later whitespace handling changes affect callers; the later smartquotes performance rewrite replaces an algorithm already present before this substitution, with no correctness fix or revert of the slice conversion.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: Unknown-option detection treats a token composed of known short flags as a recognized group even when short-option grouping is disabled. Parsing '-known' with boolean flags k,n,o,w, unknown-options-as-args enabled, and short-option-groups disabled should preserve it as the positional string '-known'.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'fix: unknown-options-as-args now respects short-option-groups (#510)'. Added test 'should not parse known short option groups when short-option-groups:false' requires the result {_: ['-known']}.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: With unknown-options-as-args enabled, ordinary positional tokens enter the unknown-option path and bypass halt-at-non-option, allowing later known flags to be parsed. For ['-v', '--long', 'arg', './file.js', '--foo', '--', 'barbar'] with both configurations enabled and foo boolean, all tokens should remain positional.
cases.evidence: Subject: 'fix(halt-at-non-option): prevent known args from being parsed when "unknown-options-as-args" is enabled (#438)'. Added test 'is not influenced by unknown options when "unknown-options-as-args" is true' asserts the complete input sequence remains in the positional array.

cases.ground_truth: BUG: The reversed sequence's arrow-function iterator reads this.size from its lexical context instead of the reversed sequence, causing iterator consumption to throw. Spreading Seq([1, 2, 3]).reverse().map(x => x * 10).reverse() should yield [10, 20, 30].
cases.evidence: Subject: 'fix(reverseFactory): use reversedSequence.size in __iterator instead of this'. Added test 'can be iterated in reverse through a lazy chain' checks both spread values and entries for the double-reverse chain.
